article.story: AKRON, Ohio -- — Ty Pence led Akron with 17 points, and Evan Mahaffey sealed the victory with a layup with 52 seconds left as the Zips defeated Tulane 65-63 on Saturday. Pence also contributed five rebounds for the Zips (3-0). Buddy Hammer Jr. and Tahj Staveskie each added 11 points. Hammer finished 5 of 6 from the floor, to go with six rebounds. T.J. Nadeau finished with 19 points and two steals for the Green Wave (2-2). K.J. Greene added 16 points, six rebounds and two steals for Tulane. Krystian Lewis finished with 11 points. Hammer scored nine points in the first half for Akron, which led 36-26 at the break. Pence scored a team-high nine points for Akron in the second half. Up next Akron plays Bucknell on the road Tuesday, and Tulane visits Louisiana Tech on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
